rationale: Closing pass: the audit's questions are all explained, no necessary gap remains, and every asserted or refuted account carries the sources and receipts it depends on, so this pass changes no record. The state of the work is: one asserted defect, the per-cluster summary that never reports a witness node as a witness, supported by two retained receipts and bounded by the field's documented meaning, the documented purpose of the call that returns it, the single producing site of the summary value and the absence of any in-tree consumer that would change a decision; everything else is a negative or an explained consequence. Those include the read-index paths on authority loss, quiesce and witness participation, the snapshot save and worker-panic paths now anchored by a launcher execution, snapshot install and restart frontiers, vote durability and its state-cache caveat, apply ordering and re-arming, chunked snapshot transfer, session deduplication and eviction, proposal and configuration-change refusal paths, membership eligibility and the witness guard that refuses client work before any request state exists. The witness summary defect is a reporting defect on a client contract: no consensus, quorum, persistence or liveness conclusion depends on it, and the witness role remains visible through the membership query that the captured documentation directs operators to for role checks.
